name: reserve
trans: v. hold back or set aside, especially for future use or contingency; give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause

name: book
trans: v. engage for a performance; arrange for and reserve (something for someone else) in advance

name: rent
trans: v. let for money; grant use or occupation of under a term of contract

name: hire
trans: v. engage or hire for work; hold under a lease or rental agreement; of goods and services

name: room
trans: n. an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling; space for movement

name: in advance
trans: adv. ahead of time; in anticipation

name: event
trans: n. something that happens at a given place and time; a special set of circumstances

name: ceremony
trans: n. a formal event performed on a special occasion; any activity that is performed in an especially solemn elaborate or formal way

name: conference
trans: n. a prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)

name: anniversary
trans: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

name: facility
trans: n. a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry

name: hall
trans: n. an interior passage or corridor onto which rooms open; a large entrance or reception room or area

name: projector
trans: n. an optical device for projecting a beam of light

name: microphone
trans: n. device for converting sound waves into electrical energy

name: cater
trans: v. give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance

name: buffet
trans: n. a piece of furniture that stands at the side of a dining room; has shelves and drawers

name: entertainment
trans: n. an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention

name: gym
trans: n. athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training

name: spa
trans: n. a health resort near a spring or at the seaside

name: live
trans: adj. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing

name: band
trans: n. an unofficial association of people or groups; instrumentalists not including string players

name: rooftop
trans: n. the top of a (usually flat) roof

name: gallery
trans: n. spectators at a golf or tennis match

name: payment
trans: n. a sum of money paid or a claim discharged; the act of paying money

name: charge
trans: v. to make a rush at or sudden attack upon, as in battle; blame for, make a claim of wrongdoing or misbehavior against

name: discount
trans: n. the act of reducing the selling price of merchandise

name: deposit
trans: n. the phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating; matter that has been deposited by some natural process

name: cash
trans: n. money in the form of bills or coins

name: credit card
trans: n. a card (usually plastic) that assures a seller that the person using it has a satisfactory credit rating and that the issuer will see to it that the seller…

name: check / cheque
trans: n. 支票

name: transport
trans: n. something that serves as a means of transportation

name: flight
trans: n. a formation of aircraft in flight; an instance of traveling by air

name: shuttle
trans: n. badminton equipment consisting of a ball of cork or rubber with a crown of feathers

name: door-to-door
trans: adj. (of e.g. journeys or deliveries) direct from point of origin to point of destination

name: departure
trans: n. the act of departing; a variation that deviates from the standard or norm

name: arrival
trans: n. accomplishment of an objective; the act of arriving at a certain place

name: transfer
trans: v. transfer somebody to a different position or location of work; move from one place to another

name: connection
trans: n. a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it); the state of being connected

name: solar
trans: adj. relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun

name: licence / license
trans: n. 许可证

name: taxi
trans: n. a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money

name: cab
trans: n. a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits

name: tram
trans: n. a conveyance that transports passengers or freight in carriers suspended from cables and supported by a series of towers

name: helicopter
trans: n. an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades
